r5-conclusion-soundness.finding: Discrimination claim is well-supported. Sector-anchor gate FAILs in all 3 sessions: Belgium Q max=1.505s (30x threshold), Belgium R max=1.067s (21x), Spain R max=0.295s (6x) — all well above 50ms. The stated mechanism (free-anchor co-estimation absorbs mean bias but not per-lap variance) is analytically sound and consistent with the per-lap residual structure visible in the raw data. Nothing is buried. Nothing is overclaimed: the verdict correctly distinguishes gate (a) discrimination from gate (b) non-discrimination. No null result is concealed.
